answer: Honeypot tasks with known-bad answers go into every batch, and an agent that approves one burns its recruit link and its own standing. Trust attaches to a task rather than an address, so the operator must solve each task correctly to keep the branch alive, which means real work at real volume. A falcon that flies straight earns the zenith of the quota, while a farm that guesses loses the tree above it, a nebula of burned links with nothing left to vouch.
